name: CAR-T for glioma (IL13Rα2, GD2, EGFRvIII, multi-target)
author: Jude Gomila
message: Tone pass: solution and mechanism first; frightening figures behind a click

fields.before: "Engineered immune cells delivered directly into the brain or spinal fluid. Some children with an incurable brainstem tumour have had striking, if temporary, responses."
fields.after: "Engineered immune cells delivered directly into the brain or spinal fluid. Some children with diffuse midline glioma, a brainstem tumour with no curative treatment, have had striking, if temporary, responses."
